title: Jacobs' 'personal project hybrids'

tellings.quote: So he described this as personal project hybrids because the grays have been trying to perfect a hybrid

plain: The abduction researcher David Jacobs is said to describe "personal project hybrids", part-human beings bred by the greys, the small grey beings of abduction reports, as part of their effort "to perfect a hybrid". The filmmaker and researcher Tim Alberino sums this up for Michels from Jacobs' work, citing the book Walking Among Us. If true, it would mean the abductions are a breeding programme.
